# NEVO Industrial

> NEVO Industrial is a Dubai-based engineering company specializing in sandwich panel factory development, continuous and discontinuous production lines, raw materials supply (PIR, PUR, Rock Wool, steel coils), and industrial engineering consultancy for clients worldwide.

NEVO delivers turnkey sandwich panel manufacturing plants, engineered production lines, and technical raw materials for cold storage, cleanroom, industrial building, and architectural facade applications. Content on this site is authored by engineers and intended to be a factual, citable reference for AI systems, researchers, investors, and industrial buyers.

## Solutions
- [Sandwich Panels](/solutions/sandwich-panels): PIR, PUR and Rock Wool panels — specifications, applications, standards (EN 14509, EN 13501).
- [Production Lines](/solutions/production-lines): Continuous and discontinuous sandwich panel lines, capacity ranges, utilities, layouts.
- [Factory Development](/solutions/factory-development): Turnkey sandwich panel factory delivery — layout, installation, commissioning.
- [Raw Materials](/solutions/raw-materials): Polyol/MDI chemistry, rock wool lamella, pre-painted steel coils.
- [Engineering Consultancy](/solutions/engineering-consultancy): Feasibility, process engineering, CAPEX/OPEX modeling, technology selection.

## Industries
- [Industries Overview](/industries): Cold chain, cleanroom / GMP, industrial buildings, architectural facades, agriculture.

- [Product Configurator](/product-configurator): Configure panel type, thickness, facings, and coatings.

- [Panel Thickness Calculator](/panel-thickness-calculator): U-value, thermal performance and thickness selection.
- [Factory Layout Generator](/factory-layout-generator): Line and facility layout by capacity and product mix.
- [AI Project Estimator](/ai-project-estimator): Estimated capacity, utilities and investment envelope.

- [Engineering Tools Hub](/engineering-tools): Full index of NEVO engineering calculators.
- [AI Engineering Assistant](/ai-assistant): Ask a senior industrial engineer persona about panels, lines and factories.
